title: Hold a permit to export or import hazardous waste
what: Exporting hazardous waste needs an export permit (and importing it an import permit) under the Act.

laws.title: Hazardous Waste (Regulation of Exports and Imports) Act 1989

sources.title: Hazardous Waste (Regulation of Exports and Imports) Act 1989
sources.quote: 33C Export of hazardous waste—basic contravention Prohibition of exports (1) A person contravenes this subsection if: (a) the person exports waste; and (b) the waste is hazardous waste; and (c) the person is not the holder of an export permit authorising the person to export the hazardous waste;

reach.condition: if it exports or imports hazardous waste
